name: Will older Salt Lake City homes require electrical panel updates for new lighting?

mainEntity.name: Will older Salt Lake City homes require electrical panel updates for new lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding lighting requires assessing your existing electrical panel capacity, especially in older Salt Lake City neighborhoods like The Avenues, Sugar House, or Harvard-Yale. Homes with older 100-amp panels or outdated wiring may require service updates to safely accommodate new circuits, modern appliances, and extensive recessed lighting layouts. During a whole-house or kitchen renovation, an assessment determines whether your current panel can handle the added loads or if expanding breaker capacity is necessary before installing new fixture runs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older homes with lower electrical capacity may require panel updates or circuit adjustments before adding extensive recessed lighting or dedicated task circuits.
